tweets.text: The Unified Coordination Group will report directly to @SecMayorkas and will include a broad range of services throughout the resettlement process.

tweets.text:
These services include:  
✅ initial immigration processing 
✅COVID-19 testing 
✅ isolation of COVID-positive individuals for anticipated quarantine 
✅resettlement support  
✅initial processing at pre-designated U.S. military bases prior to being resettled into communities.
